summary: Iteration 10 backend regression: PostHog integration + telemetry pipeline + all prior endpoints. 29/29 pytest tests pass after one backend fix (anomaly scan ObjectId serialization). PostHog graceful degradation log confirmed.

minor.issue: Returned 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId leaking into response (motor's insert_one mutates the inserted dict with `_id`). Fixed in this iteration by inserting on `dict(anomaly)` copy in `_store_anomaly()` (services/anomaly_detection.py).

action_items: (Optional) Make `POST /api/customers` legacy endpoint reject unknown camelCase->snake_case mismatched payloads or document the schema requirement (it silently falls back to defaults 'License'/'Scan' if firstName/lastName fields are not present, which can confuse callers who send snake_case).
critical_code_review_comments: services/anomaly_detection.py::_store_anomaly was mutating the caller's dict via motor's insert_one side-effect (adds `_id`), which leaked an ObjectId into the API response and broke JSON serialization. Fixed by inserting a copy.

routes/customers_v2.py has two create endpoints (POST /customers legacy camelCase and POST /customers/create snake_case). The legacy one silently substitutes defaults 'License'/'Scan' when firstName/lastName are missing — consider 400-ing instead, or document this in the route docstring.
telemetry_service.py _init_posthog() is correctly called in __init__ with graceful degradation when POSTHOG_API_KEY missing (verified via log line). All telemetry endpoints functional.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Iter10 customer + TEST-prefixed vehicle within the same test; no residual data. Telemetry events with action=test_iter10_<uuid8> persisted to MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 backend regression complete. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_telemetry_posthog.py covers health, auth (login/status/invalid PIN), strict auth enforcement (12 protected endpoints), telemetry (track/summary/sales-funnel/ai-usage), sessions (save/restore/auto-save/delete with delta wrapper), anomaly (summary+scan), customers CRUD via /api/customers/create, vehicles CRUD, and VIN OCR sanity. PostHog graceful degradation verified via backend log. One backend bug fixed: anomaly_detection _store_anomaly was mutating dict via motor's insert_one. The legacy POST /api/customers endpoint (LicenseScanner) uses camelCase; main snake_case endpoint is POST /api/customers/create.
rca of the issue: Anomaly scan 500: motor's insert_one() mutates the input dict by adding `_id` (ObjectId). `run_full_scan()` keeps the same dict reference in `results['details']`, so the API response contained an un-serializable ObjectId, causing FastAPI's jsonable_encoder to raise ValueError. Reproduction: `POST /api/anomalies/scan` with valid Bearer token while at least one anomaly exists to insert. Mitigation: insert on a shallow copy `dict(anomaly)` so the original returned dict is unchanged. Verified by re-running the test → 200 OK.
